change_summary: file-backed safetensors loaders read only the 8-byte length prefix and a bounded header before considering payload allocation
caller-configurable header and total byte quotas are enforced against the opened descriptor's exact declared size
payload and decoded tensor allocations use fallible reservations and exact bounded reads
file growth during the operation is detected
sorted tensor data_offsets must form one contiguous, non-overlapping coverage of the payload before allocation
regressions: oversized sparse file rejected before payload allocation
declared size inconsistent with descriptor size rejected

initial_finding.finding: overlapping data_offsets could amplify decoded allocations

review.exact_head_result: completed with no further major issue

current_head_reconciliation.note: The newer SciAgent commit does not touch the remediated loader. Its own push CI was still in progress at observation time and is not claimed as RT-SCI-02 validation.

acceptance: all file-backed loaders apply header and total quotas before payload allocation
exact declared length and tensor coverage are validated before allocation
the exact integrated tree passed all target workflows, including 28/28 CI jobs and both Miri numeric shards
the current repository head preserves the exact remediated safetensors blob
limitations: This qualification covers file-backed safetensors import behavior and does not claim memory safety for unrelated loaders.
CUDA jobs in CI are compile/lint fallback checks unless a hardware runtime is explicitly present; no hardware qualification is inferred.
